verdict.rationale: Superset does show some PM-adjacent capabilities — a 'Design' pane to select a UI element and send a requested change to an agent with context, sharing agent-created designs/reports with teammates and turning comments into updates, and running agents from a phone — suggesting a mockup-to-agent-prompt path. However, the core workflow still centers on Git worktrees, diff viewers, and PR creation/merge, meaning technical review and integration (the 'engineering handoff') remains baked into the product rather than eliminated. Missing for 10: explicit no-code/PM-only workflow that bypasses git/diff/PR mechanics entirely, evidence of non-engineers successfully shipping features end-to-end, and independent confirmation that PMs (not developers) use this without engineering involvement.
